name: hud_ui_options_panel_sound_active_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_SoundActive::SyncFromOptions toggles the sound-active checkbox and writes the inverse checked state to the mute-sound option.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. Current Binary Ninja HLIL renders the checked comparison as a byte temporary, but the source behavior is verified against the current decompilation.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cbb0 calls HudUiCheckToggleWidget::OnActivate, then passes self->checked == 0 to zOpt::SetMuteSoundOption, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_sound_active_sync_from_options_smoke enables the check-toggle widget, verifies activation toggles unchecked to checked and stores mute 0, then verifies the second activation toggles checked to unchecked and stores mute 1.
